scraped.scraped_description: The Public Accountability Initiative, LittleSis, is a nonprofit public interest research organization focused on corporate and government accountability.

name: LittleSis
tagline: Free database of who-knows-who at the heights of business and government — power research for just futures
dependency_risks: Reliant on volunteer researcher contributions for data quality

news_articles.headline: Hochul stalls climate action amid multi-million dollar lobbying effort by fossil fuel industry

academic_citations: Cited in peer-reviewed research on corporate influence, lobbying networks, and power mapping methodologies
awards: Recognized as leading power-mapping tool by civic tech community
policy_outcomes: Research used by advocacy organizations in fossil fuel divestment campaigns
Data cited in investigative journalism on corporate-government relationships
Training workshops for organizers and researchers on power mapping
outcome_methodology: Power-mapping research used in campaigns; training workshops for organizers; research cited in Washington Post, The Guardian, Politico, CNBC
published_performance_metrics: Database contains 200,000+ entities with relationship data; active volunteer contributor base; API usage metrics available
documented_limitations: Data coverage concentrated on US elite networks
Database relies on volunteer and staff contributions — completeness varies
failure_modes: Data staleness if volunteer contributions drop
Potential legal exposure from publishing relationship data on named individuals
curation_criteria: Curated relationship data on individuals and organisations at the heights of US business and government; data verified by staff and volunteer researchers
contributor_governance: Staff + volunteer researchers; open data submission via Information Review Form
controversies: Privacy concerns raised regarding publication of relationship data on private individuals
political_bias_allegations: Allegations of left-leaning bias in selection of entities tracked; project maintains focus on corporate and government power structures across political spectrum
legal_regulatory_issues: Potential legal challenges regarding publication of personal relationship data; project operates within First Amendment protections for public interest research
ai_involvement: No primary AI/machine learning involvement; database uses traditional relational database architecture and manual curation
political_relevance_summary: LittleSis addresses mapping communities and resources for civic engagement and addressing housing justice and tenant rights. It has documented policy impact.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizers/campaigners through Free database of who-knows-who at the heights of business and government — power research for just futures.
